_about: Reviewed differences from the WP0 baseline (test/regional/parity.mjs and smoke.mjs). 'missing': lines that may disappear; 'missingPatterns': regexes for the same; 'renames': a missing line is allowed only if the line with {from} replaced by {to} is on the page; 'doses': dose strings whose count may change. Every entry says why and which plan item allows it. Never add an entry to make a clinical change pass.
